defects.title: Idempotency-Key Fails After Soft-Deleted Payment
defects.description: When a payment is soft-deleted, replaying with the same idempotency_key returns 422 instead of creating a new payment. The pre-check uses default scope (excludes soft-deleted) but the DB unique constraint includes them.
reproduction_steps: 4. Try to add another payment with same idempotency_key='KEY_X'
defects.suggested_fix: Use FlightPayment::withTrashed() in pre-check, or clear idempotency_key on soft-deleted rows
defects.impact: Breaks legitimate retry scenarios where a payment was reversed and needs to be re-created

safety_guards_observed: Direct DB UPDATE on protected balance columns → warning logged

baseline_comparison.hypothesis: Existing tests fail due to older fixture patterns, not core logic bugs. Audit uses minimal fixtures matching current code paths.
